fields.Name: AIUsageByScope
fields.UserQuestion: What is our AI usage, tokens, and spend broken down by primary scope entity and record?
fields.Description: Aggregates AI usage facts by PrimaryScopeEntityID and PrimaryScopeRecordID. Supports optional filtering by scope entity, scope record, and date range.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates runs, success/failure counts, token metrics, own cost, and latencies grouped by PrimaryScopeEntityID and PrimaryScopeRecordID. Parameters scopeEntityId, scopeRecordId, start, and end are optional and evaluated via template conditionals.
